profile.headline: Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks
profile.summary:
Solid background in Microsoft centric solutions, with strong emphasis in Microsoft Active Directory Services. Consistently exceeds performance and reliability expectations. Experienced in handling a centrally managed environment with a large number of remote sites. Skilled in developing, implementing and maintaining standardized policies and procedures for a consistent environment.

• ASP, CGI, JSP, PHP
• Brocade Tapestry StorageX
• Brocade Connectrix Fabric Management
• Cisco Routing and Switching equipment
• Citrix Presentation Server
• Compaq Server and Rack Hardware
• DHCP, DNS, and WINS
• EMC SAN Technologies
• File\Data Backup and Recovery
• FTP
• Group Policy
• IBM Server and Rack Hardware
• IIS
• IPX/SPX Protocol
• Install Pump
• KVM and IP KVM technologies
• Lotus Notes
• Microsoft Active Directory Services
• Microsoft Exchange
• Microsoft Host Integration Server
• Microsoft Office  [Word, Excel, Access]
• Microsoft Project
• Microsoft SQL
• Microsoft Visio
• Microsoft’s Distributed File System
• MSI deployment
• MSI packaging
• Networking  [Cabling, Hardware, Standards]
• Novel 5.0
• Peregrine Service Center
• Powershell
• Pre-Boot environments
• SCSI and Raid technologies
• Symantec Ghost
• TCP/IP
• Unix
• UPS systems
• Visual Basic Script  [WMI, ADSI, WSH]
• VMWare
• Windows NT 4.0 Server OS
• Windows 2000, 2003, 2008, Server OS
• Windows 95, 98, 98SE, 2000, XP, Vista, 7 Desktop OS
• Windows file and print services

Specialties: Troubleshooting, Automation, Design and Implementation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: CyberArk acquired by Palo Alto Networks February 11, 2026

positions.title: Senior Server Support Technician
positions.description:
• POC, Design, Implement, and Support 300 device Cisco WAAS Environment
• Implemented 8 unit distributed Celerra environment with replicated/centralize ndmp backup
• Support EMC technologies (Symmetrix VMAX, Clariion, Celerra, Rainfinity FMA, Rainfinity GFV)
• Support infrastructure for HP PolyServe Environment
• 3rd level phone support for servers
• Continued support and management roles from Server Technician II position

positions.title: Server Technician II
positions.description:
• Microsoft Active Directory Services (Including Account, OU, Group Policy, Domains and Trust, Sites and Services, and Health Management)
• DFS, DHCP, DNS, and WINS
• Brocade Tapestry StorageX (FAN Product)
• Microsoft Host Integration Server 2000
• Windows Server 2000 and 2003 OS support
• Mentor new team members
• Develop automation processes and scripts (Visual Basic Script and some powershell) for redundant tasks and environment manipulation
• Develop and Documented disaster recovery processes
• Support a 800+ server and 10,000+ desktop environment
• Successfully deployed 284 NAS units to remote facilities
• Implemented Folder Redirection and Roaming Profiles at over 300 remote facilities across the enterprise
• Consistently meet SLAs and yearly goals including trouble tickets and disaster recovery exercises
• Consistently exceed expectations in performance reviews
• 2nd level phone support for servers

positions.title: PC Support Technician
positions.description:
• Creation, installation and deployment of standardized workstation images
• Developed CD based Service Pack deployment automation for mobile work force
• Developed automated Lotus Notes installation, configuration, and Exchange to Notes migration using Install Pump 
• Completed Windows 95 to Windows 2000 workstation upgrade at 7 major company facilities ranging from 50 to 300+ users.
• Wrote several utility scripts for common troubleshooting tasks
• Performed compatiblity testing and upgrades for legacy software
• Maintained software repository
• 2nd level phone support for PCs

positions.title: Support Center Technician
positions.description:
• 1st level phone support
• On-call overnight support
• Developed and maintained customer satisfaction survey process
• Developed and maintained problem analysis functionality for existing ticketing system
• Wrote Linux shell scripts to perform data colaboration and analisys
• Developed in and supported new implementation of Peregrine Service Center ticket management system.
• Created training documentation for new employees
• Maintained Support Center Knowledge Base database in Lotus Notes

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description:
• Administrative Assistant (DHCP, Unix Account, Unix Shell Script, Intrusion Detection)
• Field Maintenance (Cat 3 and Cat 5 installation and termination, installation and configuration of active concentrators and management modules, kept scheduled maintenance on equipment)
• Computer/Network troubleshooting (PC and network equipment connectivity)
• Record Keeping (Maintain organized user database, equipment maintenance log)

positions.title: Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
• Problem Solving (Learn, troubleshoot, and teach new company equipment, Introduced organization and procedure processes)
• Customer Relations (Greeting and managing customers, register administration for price adjustments, overrides, and sales)
• Inventory Control (Tagging and pricing stock, documentation in preparation for storewide inventory)

positions.title: Assistant Night Manager
positions.description:
• Kept the Ledger Book
• Counted Registers
• Ran daily deposits to company bank
• Stored excess funds in store vault
• Verified received packages and quanties
• Maintained and recored inventory totals

honors.title: Powershell Hero
honors.description:
PowerShell Heroes is our way of recognizing the people who are making significant contributions to the PowerShell community, but who haven’t received any other formal recognition (such as Microsoft’s MVP Award). In many cases, these are the rising stars we hope to see receive an MVP someday, but in all cases they’re out there, working hard to make a difference. They were nominated by their peers, and selected by the 2015 PowerShell Hero honorees.

http://powershell.org/wp/2016/04/03/announcing-our-2016-powershell-heroes/

honors.title: Windows PowerShell Technical Guru
honors.description:
Guru Award  Windows PowerShell Technical Guru - October 2015   

Gold Award Winner
 
Curtis Smith Active Directory Troubleshooting: server has returned the following error - invalid enumeration context
http://social.technet.microsoft.com/wiki/contents/articles/32418.active-directory-troubleshooting-server-has-returned-the-following-error-invalid-enumeration-context.aspx

Richard Mueller: "Good detailed troubleshooting steps. This should be very useful. The original Get-ADUser statement got cut off. It would be nice to see the rest, especially what happens after the pipe. Also, once the solution was found, it would be good to repeat the original statement." 
Chen V: "Excellent article and good presentation"
honors.issuer: Issued by Microsoft TechNet WIKI · Oct 2015
